Ben (docs): Noticed recurring questions about 'which fallback runs first' on the error-ref. Can we add a tiny decision table + one short SDK snippet?
Priya (eng-runtime): Yes. Runtime order: client retry -> middleware trim -> model variant -> region failover. Streaming is special.
Sam (devex): I'll add a compact JS snippet handling Retry-After and jitter.
Nora (eng-ml): Add a one-liner about KV cache mismatch when switching to quantized variants.
Ben (docs): I'll open a PR with the table and FAQ. Sam, please attach snippet; Priya, sanity-check thresholds.
docs-bot: PR opened by Ben: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4210
